name: Shifting Shirt
body:
Aura faint illusion; CL 1st; Slot body; Price 850 gp; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

Used by vain, lower-tier merchants, courtiers, and rascals alike, this non-descript article of clothing shifts at your whim. One moment, it resembles filthy beggar’s robes and, the next, glistening court attire. Your appearance cannot be changed, only your mode of dress. Anyone physically interacting with you might see through the illusion (Will DC 12).

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, Spells silent image; Cost 425 gp
